units.left_text: The LORD’s word that came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.
units.right_text: This is the word of the LORD that came to Joel son of Pethuel:

units.left_text: Hear this, you elders,
units.right_text: Hear this, O elders;

units.left_text: Tell your children about it,
units.right_text: Tell it to your children;

units.left_text: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten.
units.right_text: What the devouring locust has left,

units.left_text: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep!
units.right_text: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep;

units.left_text: For a nation has come up on my land, strong, and without number.
units.right_text: For a nation has invaded My land,

units.left_text: He has laid my vine waste,
units.right_text: It has laid waste My grapevine

units.left_text: Mourn like a virgin dressed in sackcloth
units.right_text: Wail like a virgin dressed in sackcloth,

units.left_text: The meal offering and the drink offering are cut off from the LORD’s house.
units.right_text: Grain and drink offerings have been cut off

units.left_text: The field is laid waste.
units.right_text: The field is ruined;

units.left_text: Be confounded, you farmers!
units.right_text: Be dismayed, O farmers,

units.left_text: The vine has dried up, and the fig tree withered—
units.right_text: The grapevine is dried up,

units.left_text: Put on sackcloth and mourn, you priests!
units.right_text: Put on sackcloth and lament, O priests;

units.left_text: Sanctify a fast.
units.right_text: Consecrate a fast;

units.left_text: Alas for the day!
units.right_text: Alas for the day!

units.left_text: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes,
units.right_text: Has not the food been cut off

units.left_text: The seeds rot under their clods.
units.right_text: The seeds lie shriveled beneath the clods;

units.left_text: How the animals groan!
units.right_text: How the cattle groan!

units.left_text: LORD, I cry to you,
units.right_text: To You, O LORD, I call,

units.left_text: Yes, the animals of the field pant to you,
units.right_text: Even the beasts of the field pant for You,

units.left_text: Blow the trumpet in Zion,
units.right_text: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion;

units.left_text: A day of darkness and gloominess,
units.right_text: a day of darkness and gloom,

units.left_text: A fire devours before them,
units.right_text: Before them a fire devours,

units.left_text: Their appearance is as the appearance of horses,
units.right_text: Their appearance is like that of horses,

units.left_text: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of the mountains, they leap,
units.right_text: With a sound like that of chariots

units.left_text: At their presence the peoples are in anguish.
units.right_text: Nations writhe in horror before them;

units.left_text: They run like mighty men.
units.right_text: They charge like mighty men;

units.left_text: One doesn’t jostle another.
units.right_text: They do not jostle one another;

units.left_text: They rush on the city.
units.right_text: They storm the city;

units.left_text: The earth quakes before them.
units.right_text: Before them the earth quakes;

units.left_text: The LORD thunders his voice before his army,
units.right_text: The LORD raises His voice

units.left_text: “Yet even now,” says the LORD, “turn to me with all your heart,
units.right_text: “Yet even now,”

units.left_text: Tear your heart and not your garments,
units.right_text: So rend your hearts and not your garments,

units.left_text: Who knows? He may turn and relent,
units.right_text: Who knows? He may turn and relent

units.left_text: Blow the trumpet in Zion!
units.right_text: Blow the ram’s horn in Zion,

units.left_text: Gather the people.
units.right_text: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation,

units.left_text: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar,
units.right_text: Let the priests who minister before the LORD

units.left_text: Then the LORD was jealous for his land,
units.right_text: Then the LORD became jealous for His land,

units.left_text: The LORD answered his people,
units.right_text: And the LORD answered His people:

units.left_text: But I will remove the northern army far away from you,
units.right_text: The northern army I will drive away from you,

units.left_text: Land, don’t be afraid.
units.right_text: Do not be afraid, O land;

units.left_text: Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field;
units.right_text: Do not be afraid, O beasts of the field,

units.left_text: “Be glad then, you children of Zion,
units.right_text: Be glad, O children of Zion,

units.left_text: The threshing floors will be full of wheat,
units.right_text: The threshing floors will be full of grain,

units.left_text: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten,
units.right_text: I will repay you for the years eaten by locusts —

units.left_text: You will have plenty to eat and be satisfied,
units.right_text: You will have plenty to eat,

units.left_text: You will know that I am among Israel,
units.right_text: Then you will know that I am present in Israel

units.left_text: “It will happen afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh;
units.right_text: And afterward, I will pour out My Spirit on all people.

units.left_text: And also on the servants and on the handmaids in those days,
units.right_text: Even on My menservants and maidservants,

units.left_text: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth:
units.right_text: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth,

units.left_text: The sun will be turned into darkness,
units.right_text: The sun will be turned to darkness

units.left_text: It will happen that whoever will call on the LORD’s name shall be saved;
units.right_text: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD

units.left_text: “For, behold, in those days,
units.right_text: “Yes, in those days and at that time,

units.left_text: I will gather all nations,
units.right_text: I will gather all the nations

units.left_text: and have cast lots for my people,
units.right_text: They cast lots for My people;

units.left_text: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre and Sidon,
units.right_text: Now what do you have against Me, O Tyre, Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering against Me a recompense? If you retaliate against Me, I will swiftly and speedily return your recompense upon your heads.

units.left_text: Because you have taken my silver and my gold,
units.right_text: For you took My silver and gold and carried off My finest treasures to your temples.

units.left_text: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks,
units.right_text: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, to send them far from their homeland.

units.left_text: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them,
units.right_text: Behold, I will rouse them from the places to which you sold them; I will return your recompense upon your heads.

units.left_text: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah,
units.right_text: I will sell your sons and daughters into the hands of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans — to a distant nation.”

units.left_text: Proclaim this among the nations:
units.right_text: Proclaim this among the nations:

units.left_text: Beat your plowshares into swords,
units.right_text: Beat your plowshares into swords

units.left_text: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations,
units.right_text: Come quickly, all you surrounding nations,

units.left_text: “Let the nations arouse themselves,
units.right_text: Let the nations be roused

units.left_text: Put in the sickle;
units.right_text: Swing the sickle,

units.left_text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision!
units.right_text: Multitudes, multitudes

units.left_text: The sun and the moon are darkened,
units.right_text: The sun and moon will grow dark,

units.left_text: The LORD will roar from Zion,
units.right_text: The LORD will roar from Zion

units.left_text: “So you will know that I am the LORD, your God,
units.right_text: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God,

units.left_text: It will happen in that day,
units.right_text: And in that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine,

units.left_text: Egypt will be a desolation
units.right_text: Egypt will become desolate,

units.left_text: But Judah will be inhabited forever,
units.right_text: But Judah will be inhabited forever,

units.left_text: I will cleanse their blood
units.right_text: For I will avenge their blood,
